title: Prepare CUPI workspace paths for the flat pilot
summary: You can prepare admitted inputs under /srv/cupi/hexapod/inputs and frozen attempts under /srv/cupi/hexapod/runs. The launcher accepts both CUPI and legacy paths and rejects symbolic paths. Contributors use personal clones and separate run directories. The pilot budget and native launcher stay unchanged.
next: Verify retained evidence and fresh pilot packages before removing the inventoried legacy copies.
reason: You gain workspace support and regression checks. No measured result, training budget or qualification gate changes.
